title: qr-graph observe line
description: One page and one embedded child, as the semantic log recorded them (`depends_on`, `dependency_skipped`) and as the code declares them.

page.description: The parent URI as logged, without query.

child.description: The child URI as logged, without query.

observed.description: The event types recorded for this pair across the sessions read; empty for an `unclassified` child.

declared.description: How the page's onGet declares the child: `referenced`/`unreferenced` for a donut page (the `usage` of its embed), `embedded` for a page without donut caching, null when no `#[Embed]` of the page names the child.

verdict.description: `material`, `hole` and `dependency` are the expected shapes. `untagged-material`: the page reads the child but the child carried no ETag or Surrogate-Key, so a change to the child's data does not reach the page's template through it. `tagged-hole`: the page does not read the child, yet it carried tags before the write. `unclassified`: the page was written (`put_donut`) but the declared child was no longer an embedded request in its body, removed with `unset()` or replaced by its body array, so it adds no tag to the page even when the page read it. `skipped`: a skipped child of a page the scan does not see as donut-cached. `undeclared`: no declaration to compare with. `mixed`: the sessions disagree.
